NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE VI: LAVASTONES AND THE SCHOOLS OF THOUGHT (LCF-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Lavastones, the glowing orange-pink stones of Isola's lore, found on beaches and falling from the sky, and what they cost; and the island's schools of thought, Nature, Science, Spiritualism and Magic, arguing with and borrowing from each other.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: Two healers disagree: herbs and rest, or ritual and prayer: try both, or let the patient choose.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A fisher has a fever that will not break. (subject) wants to treat it with bitter bark tea and rest. (friend) wants to hold the old healing ritual, with prayers and smoke. They have been arguing over the patient's head. The patient would like them both to be quiet. What should happen?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: They do both: tea in the morning, ritual at night. The fever breaks on the fourth day. (subject) says it was the tea. (friend) says it was the ritual. The fisher says it was getting some sleep without anyone arguing over (other.him/her).

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: They ask the fisher, who chooses the tea, and then quietly asks (friend) to say a prayer anyway, just once. The fever breaks slowly. Both healers learn something about listening.
